name: Excal Inc
old_description: Excal Inc. is a modern brass and bronze foundry serving our customer’s requirements in a variety of ways. We produce sand castings in any volume in a wide range of sizes across any industry with a focus on meeting your quality and delivery needs.
about:
Excal Inc. operates a brass and bronze sand casting foundry in Mills, Wyoming, from an 85,000-square-foot facility that opened in 1991 when founder Fred Harmon relocated the business from its predecessor, Buckeye Brass Foundry (established 1966). The company employs more than 50 people and is now a member of the Foundrion Group, a network of non‑ferrous foundries across North America.

The foundry produces sand castings weighing 1 to 2,000 pounds in a wide range of brass, bronze, and stainless‑steel alloys. Two independent high‑production green‑sand molding lines and two no‑bake/air‑set lines run alongside four melting furnaces capable of 60,000 pounds per day. In‑house capabilities include pattern making, coremaking (with a custom Palmer Coremaker), heat treating, five CNC turning centers, two CNC mills, spectrometer inspection, and an ERP system for full traceability.

Excal serves industries such as pump and valve, water metering, fire protection, electrical, lighting, marine, irrigation, water treatment, and broader waterworks, infrastructure, and energy markets. Customers range from prototype programs to multi‑thousand‑part production runs, all machined to finished condition under one roof.

The company emphasizes built‑in redundancy — multiple molding lines and furnaces prevent single‑point‑of‑failure delays — and full in‑house control from pattern to final inspection. It also highlights flexible volume handling and broad alloy expertise, including the ability to accommodate non‑standard grades on request.
